newsitem.title: FRANCE: France deplores Sierra Leone coup, urges order.
newsitem.headline: France deplores Sierra Leone coup, urges order.

text.p: France on Monday deplored the military takeover in Sierra Leone and urged a quick return to constitutional order.
"France deplores that a group of military officers has seized power by force," Foreign Ministry spokesman Jacques Rummelhardt said after the civilian government was toppled on Sunday.

"France calls for the quick restoration of constitutional legality in Freetown," he told reporters at a routine briefing. He said the crisis, after previous coups, underscored the problems of establishing democracy.
Sierra Leone's new military rulers said on Monday they planned to bring rebels of the Revolutionary United Front into the government to consolidate an elusive peace in the country's civil war.

Self-proclaimed head of state Major Johnny Paul Koromah said he had overthrown President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah because his elected government had failed to consolidate peace and the political situation had encouraged tribal conflict.
